traits.name: Social
traits.description: Draws energy from company and seeks people out.

traits.name: Loner
traits.description: Needs quiet; crowds wear them down.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: Faces danger head-on and goes where others will not.

traits.name: Cautious
traits.description: Avoids risk and prefers the safe plan.

traits.name: Kind
traits.description: Helps without being asked and comforts the hurting.

traits.name: Abrasive
traits.description: Says what they think, whether or not anyone wants it.

traits.name: Optimist
traits.description: Finds the bright side, even here.

traits.name: Pessimist
traits.description: Expects the worst and is rarely disappointed.

traits.name: Diligent
traits.description: Works long and well.

traits.name: Lazy
traits.description: Finds a reason to rest.

traits.name: Curious
traits.description: Must know what lies over the next hill.

traits.name: Romantic
traits.description: Falls in love easily and deeply.

traits.name: Stubborn
traits.description: Once decided, will not be moved.

traits.name: Gourmand
traits.description: Lives for a good meal.

traits.name: Green Thumb
traits.description: Plants thrive under their care.

traits.name: Tinkerer
traits.description: Happiest with a tool in hand.

traits.name: Spiritual
traits.description: Senses meaning in the land itself.

traits.name: Leader
traits.description: Others listen when they speak.

traits.name: Hot-headed
traits.description: Quick to anger, quick to swing.

traits.name: Night Owl
traits.description: Comes alive after dark.

traits.name: Homesick
traits.description: Dreams of the home they walked away from.

traits.name: Resilient
traits.description: Bends but does not break.

traits.name: Pious
traits.description: Prays readily and believes deeply.

traits.name: Sceptic
traits.description: Wants proof, and fear does not count.

ambitions.name: Master a Craft
ambitions.description: Reach the highest level in their favourite skill.

ambitions.name: Raise a Family
ambitions.description: Find a partner and raise a child in this valley.

ambitions.name: Befriend the Village
ambitions.description: Count many of the village as friends.

ambitions.name: Map the Wilds
ambitions.description: See the far places of the valley with their own eyes.

ambitions.name: Raise a Shrine
ambitions.description: See an altar to the god stand where they live.

ambitions.name: Build a Home
ambitions.description: Live in a home of their own making.

ambitions.name: Lead the Village
ambitions.description: Be the most respected voice in their settlement.

memories: buried a child on the road
once saw a light walk across a lake
left a debt unpaid in the last town
can name every star but not their father
lost a house to fire and will not light one indoors
has walked further than anyone they know
keeps a stone from the first home they ever had
dreams of a tree that speaks
